2026.8.23 Update Notice:

All images in this gallery have been regenerated and re-uploaded.

The previous version was affected by an alpha-compositing bug in my sprite renderer, which caused semi-transparent anti-aliased edge pixels to have their alpha applied twice. This could produce thin 1-pixel transparent seams between some body and facial-expression layers.

This was a problem with my compositor, not with the original TLG assets or layer coordinates. The compositing method has now been corrected, and all affected images have been replaced.

2026.8.23 更新说明：

本画廊中的所有图片均已重新生成并重新上传。

之前使用的立绘合成器存在 Alpha 合成错误，半透明抗锯齿边缘的透明度被重复计算，导致身体与表情等图层的交界处出现约 1 像素宽的透明接缝。

该问题来自我的合成器，并非原始 TLG 图层或坐标存在问题。目前合成方式已经修正，所有受影响的图片均已重新生成并替换。

Character sprites extracted from D.C.5 Sweet Happiness.

Due to the large number of character sprites and expression variants, the complete character sprite collection has been divided into four galleries.

D.C.5 Sweet Happiness uses HXV4-based resource obfuscation, so the original sprite assets had to be extracted and reconstructed before they could be organized.

This collection contains all valid character sprite combinations available in the game, based on the original sprite composition rules.

This gallery is Part 4 of 4 and the final part of the collection.

从《D.C.5 Sweet Happiness》游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

由于本作人物立绘及表情差分数量较多，完整的人物立绘合集共分为四个画廊上传。

《D.C.5 Sweet Happiness》采用了基于 HXV4 的资源混淆，因此需要先对原始立绘素材进行提取与还原，再进行整理。

本合集收录按照游戏原始立绘组合规则能够成立的全部有效人物立绘组合。
